scientific_integrity: The all-width proof is by explicit homotopy-preserving presentation-complex transformations. Bounded finite checks corroborate but do not prove infinite validity. No independent verification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary three-row chessboard complexes and the full cyclic column shift at all widths n >= 5; no other subgroup quotient or equivariant classification. An equivalent unindexed homotopy splitting is a residual priority risk.
title: Uniform Moore-space splitting of cyclic three-row chessboard quotients
